'''Salis D'aar University''' was an educational establishment based in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Yeorg Captison]] studied a full program in government and economics at the [[University/Legends|university]].
